faqs.question: Who is Chum and where are they based?
faqs.answer: Chum is a San Francisco Bay Area Phish tribute and improvisational rock/jam band founded in 2010. With 200+ shows performed, Chum is one of the longest-running Phish tribute acts in the United States, performing across Northern California, Lake Tahoe, Las Vegas, and the West Coast.

faqs.question: Who are the members of Chum?
faqs.answer: Chum's lineup features Eric Ingersoll (keyboards and vocals), Chris Detrick (guitar and vocals), Chad Kimner (bass and vocals), and Alex Bowman (drums and vocals), with occasional guest appearances on guitar by Eric Schiff. The band also honors the memory of keyboardist and vocalist John Greene (2014–2025).

faqs.question: Does Chum only play Phish songs, or can they play a broader classic rock and jam-band set?
faqs.answer: In addition to 140+ Phish originals spanning eras 1.0 through 4.0, Chum's 200+ song repertoire includes 70+ classic rock, funk, progressive rock, new wave, Grateful Dead, and bluegrass covers across 35+ artists including Talking Heads, The Rolling Stones, The Beatles, Led Zeppelin, David Bowie, Pink Floyd, Frank Zappa, Little Feat, Stevie Wonder, ZZ Top, The Cars, The Velvet Underground, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. Chum can tailor either a deep-cut Phish tribute show or a high-energy crossover classic-rock and jam set for breweries, festivals, corporate events, and private parties.

faqs.question: What venues and special events has Chum played?
faqs.answer: Chum has headlined flagship Northern California venues including Great American Music Hall (SF), The UC Theatre (Berkeley), The Chapel (SF), The Catalyst (Santa Cruz), Terrapin Crossroads Grate Room (San Rafael), Crystal Bay Casino (Lake Tahoe), Cornerstone (Berkeley), Felton Music Hall, Moe's Alley, and HopMonk Tavern, alongside corporate and special events including Dreamforce, Oakland Ballers Stadium, Las Vegas Phish Sphere after-parties, SF Bay boat cruises, weddings, and milestone private parties.

faqs.question: Where can I listen to live recordings of Chum?
faqs.answer: More than 47 full live concert recordings of Chum are available to stream and download for free on the Internet Archive's Live Music Archive (https://archive.org/details/ChumATributeToPhish) and directly through the audio player on chumphishtribute.com.

faqs.question: How do I book Chum for a venue, festival, or private event?
faqs.answer: For booking inquiries, contact No Brainer Productions at nobrainerproductions831@gmail.com. Chum is a 4-piece band available for 1-set, 2-set, or 3+ hour shows across the SF Bay Area, Santa Cruz, Wine Country (Sonoma/Napa/Marin), Sacramento/Foothills, and Lake Tahoe. For general band inquiries, email chumphishtribute@gmail.com.
